types.name: struct span<T>
types.description: A struct describing a contiguous sequence without owning its storage.

fields.name: length
fields.description: Number of elements in the view.

functions.name: size
functions.description: Returns the number of elements in a span.

functions.name: str_as_bytes
functions.description: Views a null-terminated string as bytes.
functions.returnDescription: A byte span over the string contents.

functions.name: as_str
functions.description: Views a byte span as a string reference.
functions.returnDescription: A string view over the byte data.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns an optional reference to an in-range element.
functions.returnDescription: Some element reference when the index is valid.

functions.name: at
functions.description: Returns an in-range element reference or terminates on failure.
functions.returnDescription: A mutable reference to the selected element.

functions.name: first
functions.description: Returns an optional reference to the first element.
functions.returnDescription: Some first element reference when the span is non-empty.

functions.name: last
functions.description: Returns an optional reference to the last element.
functions.returnDescription: Some last element reference when the span is non-empty.
